SCI-FLT-FIXED v0.1 r0.3 — FINAL TARGETED
SCIENTIFIC-CLOSURE AND SOURCE-PREFLIGHT DIRECTIVE

The SCI-FLT-FIXED r0.2 architecture is accepted as the basis for the next
targeted revision.

Preserve:

- SCI-FLT-FIXED as the package name;
- SCI-FLT-INF as a non-authored holding tranche;
- FLT-FIXED-CONV as the sole numerical base family;
- FLT-FIXED-CONV-LOWPASS only as a qualified convolution subtype;
- strict linearity with no additive term;
- one exact sampled convolution applied exactly once;
- one exact frozen parent membership and J_full;
- A_Theta,J = J_full L_Theta;
- full-footprint-only as the sole v0.1 edge method;
- no extension, wrapping, truncation, support renormalization, inpainting,
  replacement, reprojection, resampling, deconvolution, or relearning;
- distinct MAP observation, MAP coadd, and JINC observation parent roles;
- no assumed filter/coadd commutation;
- transformed parent-map amplitude as the output quantity;
- no automatic filtered-beam, calibration, source-amplitude, or flux claim;
- separate response families and exact one-time operator application;
- deterministic covariance separate from NOI empirical uncertainty;
- request-qualified response and covariance companions;
- candidate-before-publication lifecycle;
- exposure lineage distinct from influence;
- disabled, identity, zero, unavailable, failed, and realized states;
- prospective numerical-comparison policy;
- every existing claim ceiling and nonclaim.

Do not inspect implementation, configuration, schemas, tests, audits, repairs,
validation, reductions, generated products, defaults, historical behavior, or
production status.

Do not renumber SCI-FLT-FIXED-REQ-001--044 or
SCI-FLT-FIXED-PRED-001--024. Amend exact draft wording with a semantic-change
map and append new identifiers only for genuinely new clauses.

======================================================================
1. BIND THE EXACT SIGNAL ROLE OF EVERY PARENT
======================================================================

Add a normative parent-role table.

At minimum bind:

    FLT-PARENT-MAP-OBS
      m = exact base/unfiltered MAP observation signal role;

    FLT-PARENT-MAP-COADD
      m = exact base/unfiltered MAP coadd signal role;

    FLT-PARENT-JINC-OBS
      m = exact normalized JINC map role on its admitted local support.

For the JINC parent, bind the exact role names from the current JINC boundary.

The complete five-role JINC bundle remains atomic, but its numerator, signed
normalization, quadratic accumulator, and coefficient-squared temporal
accounting are not alternate FLT signal vectors.

State explicitly:

- only the selected signal role receives L_Theta as FLT-SIG;
- parent response receives the typed response composition;
- parent covariance receives the typed covariance composition;
- support and validity are not convolved as signal;
- exposure is not convolved into physical exposure;
- normalization and coefficient diagnostics remain parent facts;
- no other map-shaped role is transformed without a separately named method.

Add a prediction that attempts to filter JINC N, C, Q, temporal accounting,
MAP exposure, support, validity, covariance, or response as FLT-SIG are rejected
under the ordinary method.

======================================================================
2. OWNER-DISPOSITION EXACT-ZERO AND REQUIRED-FOOTPRINT SEMANTICS
======================================================================

The r0.2 rule makes every stored geometric zero a required parent dependency.

Return one explicit owner decision.

Preferred disposition:

    K_geom_science
      = exact scientific geometric footprint, independent of serialization;

    K_store
      = storage/serialization footprint and scientifically nonauthoritative;

    K_nonzero
      = exact offsets whose canonical coefficient is nonzero;

    K_req
      = K_nonzero

for the ordinary fixed-convolution method.

Exact zero is determined from the canonical coefficient representation, never
from a floating tolerance.

Dense, sparse, cropped, or zero-padded storage of the same scientific kernel
shall not change K_geom_science, K_nonzero, K_req, S_out, response, covariance,
or product identity.

A zero-valued offset may be added to K_req only under a separately named method
that provides a scientific support reason independent of storage layout.

Retain the special cases:

- identity:
      K_req = {0};

- exact zero operator:
      inherits one exact admitted parent-support row domain and does not acquire
      arbitrary storage rows through an empty-footprint predicate.

If the owner instead retains K_req = K_geom_science, state that decision
explicitly, remove “or storage footprint,” and require K_geom_science to be
representation-invariant.

Update REQ-009, REQ-012, REQ-038, PRED-009, PRED-022, the rationale, and the
ECS consistently.

======================================================================
3. CLOSE COVARIANCE AUTHORITY / REPRESENTATION COMPATIBILITY
======================================================================

Add one exact compatibility table.

A. Complete parent covariance:
   authorize exact A C A^T on its complete domain and any mathematically exact
   declared output representation.

B. Explicit independent-diagonal parent model:
   authorize the full output covariance relative to that exact conditional
   model, including induced off-diagonal terms.

C. Marginal parent variances only:
   do not infer independence;
   do not calculate an exact output marginal variance for any row mixing more
   than one parent variable;
   make the output covariance/marginal role unavailable or explicitly partial.

   A separately named diagonal-contribution diagnostic may be allowed, but it
   shall not be called variance, covariance, uncertainty, or precision.

D. Structured or partial parent model:
   permit only operations proved exact for that representation and domain.

E. Unavailable parent stochastic authority:
   output covariance remains unavailable, except for separately stated local
   zero-operator parent-payload facts.

State explicitly:

    Var(y_i)
      = sum_j A_ij^2 Var(m_j)
        + 2 sum_{j<k} A_ij A_ik Cov(m_j,m_k).

Therefore marginal input variances alone generally do not determine output
marginals.

Add a prediction using two parent covariance matrices with identical diagonal
entries but different cross terms. Their filtered output variances shall differ;
a marginal-only parent shall not select either result.

Retain all existing model-conditional and unknown-cross-term warnings.

======================================================================
4. MAKE NOI COMPATIBILITY AND ATTACHMENT IMMUTABLE
======================================================================

Do not place a later-changing attachment state inside the immutable FLT bundle.

Replace the atomic-bundle role:

    FLT-NOI-ATTACHMENT-STATE

with:

    FLT-NOI-COMPATIBILITY.

The immutable FLT role shall contain:

- exact FLT product identity;
- exact operator and row-domain identity;
- exact FLT-to-NOI boundary/profile compatibility;
- fixed-state transformation semantics;
- request state known at FLT publication;
- typed compatibility or unavailability;
- no identity of a future NOI product.

A later realized NOI product shall reference the immutable FLT parent.

Any optional reverse relation shall be a separately versioned artifact, for
example:

    SCI-FLT-FIXED_TO_SCI-NOI-RELATION,

and shall not be part of FLT atomic completion or mutate the FLT bundle.

Update Section 10, REQ-027, REQ-030, the rationale, the ECS, and add a
nonmutation prediction.

======================================================================
5. REPAIR POLICY DOMAINS AND THE CONSUMER-ACTION BOUNDARY
======================================================================

The present input_row_admission profile evaluates a candidate output row.

Replace or clarify the policy architecture.

Preferred structure:

    SCI-FLT-FIXED:input_bundle_admission@1
      evaluates the complete parent bundle and plan;

    SCI-FLT-FIXED:input_parent_row_admission@1
      evaluates each exact parent row for the FLT named use;

    J_full and S_out
      are deterministic FLT-owned constructions from those parent-row decisions,
      K_req, parent domain, availability, finiteness, and required predicates.

Do not make output-row arithmetic support a producer fact or allow VAL to
perform the convolution.

For publication:

- the policy/profile defines the disposition and prescribed consumer action;
- VAL may bind and evaluate the policy and produce the decision artifact;
- the FLT publisher performs or declines the publication action;
- FLT owns final realization and FLT-local validity.

A profile or VAL evaluation shall not itself “perform publication.”

If publication is instead an internal FLT rule rather than a VAL-governed named
use, label it as such and do not imply Registry evaluation.

Retain the four-axis request/applicability/eligibility/realization semantics and
all request-specific response/covariance qualifications.

Rename profile identities before Registry approval; once registered, do not
repair misleading names by prose.

======================================================================
6. COMPLETE THE LOW-PASS TRANSFORM CONVENTION
======================================================================

Every low-pass-qualified plan shall bind:

- exact discrete/Fourier transform sign convention;
- transform normalization;
- coordinate and spatial-frequency units;
- zero-frequency origin and ordering;
- positive/negative and Nyquist-frequency treatment;
- exact frequency sample grid;
- whether the declared response is complex H, amplitude |H|, power |H|^2, or
  another exact quantity;
- linear-ratio versus decibel attenuation;
- passband, transition, and stopband region geometry;
- complex-phase branch or unwrapping convention;
- anisotropy convention;
- WCS metric relation.

For a pixel-index kernel, an allowed reference relation may be of the form:

    H(nu) = sum_r k(r) exp[-2 pi i nu dot r],

but the exact adopted convention shall be content-bound rather than inferred.

PRED-024 shall use the identical convention. A complete metadata record with a
different transform convention shall fail.

Retain the distinction between the sampled/interior transfer and the complete
finite row-restricted A_Theta,J.

======================================================================
7. TIGHTEN FULL-PROCEDURE RESPONSE DOMAIN COMPATIBILITY
======================================================================

For:

    Delta y_parent-FP
      = A_Theta,J Delta m_parent-FP,

require the baseline and perturbed parent-procedure products to provide one
exact compatible parent-grid difference on the frozen FLT domain.

If the parent procedure changes row membership, availability, WCS, quantity,
or support so that the difference is not defined on the frozen required
footprint:

- do not re-resolve J_full;
- retain the parent state-change record;
- make the affected transformed full-procedure response unavailable.

A common numerical array shape does not establish a valid procedure difference.

======================================================================
8. CONSOLIDATE SOURCE AND AUTHORITY BINDING
======================================================================

Return the actual bytes of:

- SCI-FLT-FIXED_AUTHOR_PACKET v0.1/r0.1;
- all seventeen admitted objects;
- the exact r0.2 owner directive;
- MAP-to-FLT, JINC-to-FLT, and FLT-to-NOI boundaries;
- all policy/profile drafts;
- the numerical-comparison policy draft;
- TRACEABILITY.json;
- BUILD_BINDING.json;
- source-closure, owner-parity, core/view-parity, semantic-change, profile,
  rebuild, and visual-QA reports;
- all source files and rendered PDFs.

Reproduce every quoted SHA-256.

Create one superseding r0.3 authority manifest or proposed freeze manifest
binding the complete final authority set. Do not require a future reader to
combine an older seventeen-object manifest with later normative directives and
profiles manually.

If any claimed boundary, owner decision, profile, or parity record cannot be
reproduced, return only its dependent route to typed unavailability.

======================================================================

======================================================================

Keep the rationale concise.

Add:

1. one diagram showing:
       parent signal role
       -> parent-row admission
       -> frozen J_full
       -> one sampled convolution
       -> FLT bundle
       -> optional separate NOI child;

2. one route-status table covering:
       generic contract,
       MAP observation parent,
       MAP coadd parent,
       JINC parent,
       base signal,
       low-pass qualification,
       response-qualified product,
       covariance-qualified product,
       NOI compatibility,
       profile registration,
       implementation assessment.

Verify:

- one exact shared core in all views;
- SCI-FLT-FIXED-REQ-001--044 without gaps;
- SCI-FLT-FIXED-PRED-001--024 without gaps;
- any appended IDs use the next available number;
- core/rationale/ECS semantic parity;
- exact source hashes;
- all PDFs reopen and render without clipping, overlap, broken glyphs, or
  malformed identifiers;
- title, owner, revision, date, status, and metadata agree.
